class.name: GDScriptValidator
class.brief_description: Tool to check for errors and warnings on GDScript source code.
class.description: [GDScriptValidator] validates GDScript source code against the project filesystem and reports errors and warnings found while analyzing the script and its dependencies. [warning] This class is only available in Editor builds.[/warning]

method.name: get_dependencies_with_errors
method.description: Returns a list of paths pointing to scripts with errors preventing validated source code from being valid.

method.name: get_dependency_error
method.description: Returns an error description for a given [param dependency] and [param idx].

method.name: get_dependency_error_count
method.description: Returns the amount of errors detected for a given [param dependency].

method.name: get_dependency_error_end_column
method.description: Returns at which column of the [param dependency]'s source code the [param idx] error ends.

method.name: get_dependency_error_end_line
method.description: Returns at which line of the [param dependency]'s source code the [param idx] error ends.

method.name: get_dependency_error_start_column
method.description: Returns at which column of the [param dependency]'s source code the [param idx] error starts.

method.name: get_dependency_error_start_line
method.description: Returns at which line of the [param dependency]'s source code the [param idx] error starts.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns description of the error with index [param idx].

method.name: get_error_count
method.description: Returns the amount of errors in the validated source code.

method.name: get_error_end_column
method.description: Returns at which column of the validated source code the [param idx] error ends.

method.name: get_error_end_line
method.description: Returns at which line of the validated source code the [param idx] error ends.

method.name: get_error_start_column
method.description: Returns at which column of the validated source code the [param idx] error starts.

method.name: get_error_start_line
method.description: Returns at which line of the validated source code the [param idx] error starts.

method.name: get_safe_lines
method.description: Returns a list of line indices where type safety is warranted.

method.name: get_validated_code
method.description: Returns the source code being validated.

method.name: get_validated_path
method.description: Returns the file path associated to the code being validated.

method.name: get_warning
method.description: Returns description of the warning with index [param idx].

method.name: get_warning_count
method.description: Returns the amount of warnings found in the validated code.

method.name: get_warning_end_column
method.description: Returns at which column of the validated source code the [param idx] warning ends.

method.name: get_warning_end_line
method.description: Returns at which line of the validated source code the [param idx] warning ends.

method.name: get_warning_start_column
method.description: Returns at which column of the validated source code the [param idx] warning starts.

method.name: get_warning_start_line
method.description: Returns at which line of the validated source code the [param idx] warning starts.

method.name: get_warning_string_code
method.description: Returns a code indicating what type the [param idx] warning is. Warning level of each type can be configured in [ProjectSettings] in the section [code]debug/gdscript/warnings[/code].

method.name: has_dependency_errors
method.description: Returns true if the validated code depends on any other script with errors.

method.name: has_errors
method.description: Returns true if the validated code has errors or depends on any other script with errors.

method.name: has_warnings
method.description: Returns true if the validated code has any detected warning.

method.name: validate
method.description: Analyze source [param code] in search of errors and warnings. If [param path] is provided, the analyzer will consider the given [param code] to be the contents of said file instead of the one in the filesystem.
